Today
/
Question of the day
THURSDAY, 5 NOVEMBER 2026
TypeScript question of the day

TypeScript adds static type checking to JavaScript. Explore how types describe values and relationships, and what the compiler can check before the code runs.

typeof reads the type the compiler inferred for obj; decide whether the property values 1 and 2 were kept as literals or widened when the object was created.

One question a day from a different track. No account needed; nothing is recorded.

TypeScript
Difficulty 4
What is T?
const obj = { a: 1, b: 2 };
type T = typeof obj;
1
number
2
{ a: number; b: number }
3
{ a: 1; b: 2 }
4
{ readonly a: 1; readonly b: 2 }
Check answer

JavaScript · Foundations · Level 1

Digit sum
Difficulty
Easy

Write digitSum(n), returning the sum of the decimal digits of a nonnegative safe-integer Number, from 0 through Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER (9007199254740991).

Practice a while loop and arithmetic instead of text conversion. digitSum(493) gives 16; a single digit is its own sum and zero gives 0. The caller guarantees this domain, so no validation is required.

Examples
digitSum(9007199254740991) → 
expected
76
digitSum(493) → 
expected
16
digitSum(1234) → 
expected
10
Desired complexity: O(log n)
